downscale.description:
Strategy used when a mask region is larger than the maximum number of qubits allows:

- `true` — the region is downscaled to fit, blurred, and upscaled back.
- `false` — the region is split into adjacent tiles that are blurred independently.
downscale.title: Downscale

reach.description:
Controls how far from its original position a pixel can be affected by the blur:

- `0` — fully local: only nearby pixels are affected (default).
- `1` — fully non-local: pixels anywhere on the canvas can be affected equally.
reach.title: Reach

size.description: Pixel budget per blur pass: a region up to `size × size` pixels is blurred in a single pass. Internally converted to a qubit budget via `ceil(log2(size)) * 2`. Must be between 8 and 1024. Default 1024.
size.title: Size

strength.description:
Strength of the effect, which controls the rotation applied to each qubit:

- `0` — the image is left unchanged.
- `1` — maximum blur.
strength.title: Strength

style.description:
Quantum gate used to apply the effect:

- `rx` — rotation around the x-axis of the Bloch sphere.
- `ry` — rotation around the y-axis of the Bloch sphere.
style.title: Style

inputFiles.name: image
inputFiles.description: The image of your choice. The blur effect is applied RGB pixel values only, not the alpha channel. It means that if you submitted a PNG with transparent background, the background from the output will also be transparent.

inputFiles.name: mask
inputFiles.description:
Optional mask controlling where the effect is applied, on a per-pixel
basis. Must match the size of `image`. Each output pixel is a soft
blend `C = m · C_blurred + (1 - m) · C_original`, where `m` is the
normalised mask intensity at that pixel: black keeps the original,
white takes the fully blurred version, and grey values blend smoothly
between the two. Single-channel masks are used directly; RGB masks are
converted to luminance.

**Alpha-channel fallback**

If no mask is provided, the alpha channel of `image` is used instead
(transparent pixels keep the original, opaque pixels are blurred). For
RGB input with no alpha channel, the whole image is blurred.

errorCodes.description: Image with downscale=false and the given max_qubits would require more than 200 quantum tiles. Enable downscale or increase max_qubits.
Mask dimensions do not match the image dimensions.
The provided mask has no non-zero pixels — nothing to blur.
One or more params fields failed Pydantic validation.
The image or mask file could not be decoded.
The quantum blur circuit failed on a mask region.
A mask region could not be extracted from the image (e.g. an invalid bounding box).
A blurred region could not be blended back into the output image.
The output image could not be encoded in the input's format.
